name: Fret Food
description: Chord-change practice as an arcade kitchen. Every order is a progression; play the chord the ticket wants and that step is cooked. The pot is the clock: change before it drops under the line and the step comes out clean.

minigame.title: Fret Food
minigame.tagline: Cook the order. Play the chord the ticket wants and the step is done. Pace, burners and mode are chosen at the counter.
